_meta.purpose: Tier-list & comp reasoning layer: per-witch roles/clusters/interference-fit + weighting-model inputs. Pairs with skills.json (mechanics) and the site's guides.json (content-specific tier placements).
clusters: DODGE-COUNTER CLUSTER: Xinzi, Yun, Yuhong, Alice, Lumi, Huarui, Xini build around dodging (dodge counters, atk-speed/crit-on-dodge). They want dodge uptime; some also enable allies' dodges (Yuhong's Tactical Comms feeds off ally dodges).
BLOCK-COUNTER CLUSTER: Garana, Carmen, Yun, Zhijie, Qing, Budi proc off blocking.

COUNTER-PAYOFF ENABLERS: Alice's Passive stacks Class/Special bonus damage on EVERY ally counter (max 5); Zhijie shaves her Special CD per ally counter. => a counter-heavy team (dodge/block counterers) directly powers Alice & Zhijie. Concrete comp axis for guides.

EXTREME-BATTERY / EXTREME-CENTRIC: Tomoe (low 180 charge; Class builds own Extreme charge +10/stage x4; Passive resets Class CD on every Extreme; Interference buffs allies on Extreme use) and Huarui (Interference stacks atk-speed on Extreme; Extreme plus enables Special spam). Tomoe loops her own Extreme fast and can act as an Extreme enabler/battery for Extreme-hungry carries. Xini also self-charges: her Passive 'Balanced Glide' grants +30 Extreme charge on every dodge (CD 2s), making a dodge-heavy Xini a fast self-battery for her own Extreme. Patra is the extreme-SNOWBALL endpoint: Class [Charge Amp] (+30-32) and her Special plus (+15-16) both feed her own Extreme charge, and her Passive resets her Class CD whenever an ALLY ARCANIST casts Extreme -> pair her with Tomoe (Arcanist battery) and Peseshet (Extreme-damage amp) for a self-accelerating Extreme core.

TEAM-BUFF AURA SUPPORTS: Tomoe (ally bonus-damage zone + ally attack zone), Carmen (heal/toughness/def + displacement-res shred), Garana (ally def + enemy damage-taken debuff), Maro (heal; boosts HUMAN-race healing), Zhijie (heal/support).

DEBUFF/SHRED STACK (focus-fire comp): Garana (enemy -damage-dealt AND takes-more-damage debuffs) + Carmen (displacement-res shred) + weakness-exploiters like Xinzi (bonus dmg vs Physical Weakness) => stack multipliers on a single target.
FACTION AXIS: race matters for some kits - e.g. Maro's Compassionate Gift only boosts HUMAN-race witches' healing. Track race_type when we have it for tier-list/team-building filters.

OPEN THREADS for tier list: (1) quantify Tomoe/Carmen/Garana as support value; (2) map which witches supply dodge vs block triggers to pair with counter-payoff carries; (3) Extreme-charge economy - who charges fastest / enables Extreme spam.

EXTREME-DAMAGE AMPLIFICATION AXIS: Peseshet is a dedicated team Extreme-damage buffer - Special 'Sacred Torch' grants ALL allies +Extreme damage, and her Extreme buffs one ally's Extreme damage +20%. Pairs directly with Extreme carries (Tomoe, Huarui) and any big-Extreme nuker. Combined with Tomoe (Extreme battery) you get a charge-fast + hits-harder Extreme core.

SALVO-CHAIN MECHANIC (recurring design): some kits chain auto-triggers off action types - [Normal Attack Salvo] fires after a normal combo, [Class Skill Salvo] after a Class skill, [Ultimate/Extreme Salvo] after an Extreme. Examples: Peseshet (normal combo -> Prayer's Descent Class heal -> Sacred Torch Special), Huarui (normal finisher -> Leg Cruncher Special; Passive lets Special follow the 2nd normal), Garana (Sound-Breaking Noise Special fires off Extreme/Class), Lumi (Spray Can Refill off normal finisher). Attack-speed buffs (many witches) accelerate these chains. Grina adds a clean Class->Special example: her 'Spinning Ball Strike' Special is a [Class Skill Salvo] (canonical tag ClassFollowUp) that fires after every 'Racket Concentration' Class use. Qing adds an [Ultimate/Extreme Salvo] example: 'Financial Ruling' Special (canonical tag ExtremeFollowUp) auto-fires after her Extreme 'Debt Judgment'.

EXECUTION CLUSTER: [Execution] skills only hit DOWNED/knocked-down targets. Executioners: Dusan (Void Convergence Gaze), Jenny (Bear Plushie Toss), Leed (Twin Blades Heart Breaker). Comp shape: (1) DOWNERS apply Stagger/Dizzy (Garana dizzy; Leed = huge stagger across her whole kit; Tomoe/Xinzi/Huarui stagger; Carmen; Dusan's Extreme 50 Stagger); (2) EXECUTIONERS capitalize; (3) Dusan's Passive PLUS buffs her attack speed off ALLY Executions. LEED IS THE LINCHPIN: she both downs (stagger engine) AND executes, so she is near self-sufficient for the loop and a perfect partner for Dusan (Leed's executions trigger Dusan's ally-execution payoff). Dusan+Leed(+support) = a downed-target execution core. XUANJI joins as a heavy executioner AND execution-team enabler: her Extreme 'Final Twilight' self-staggers (downs), her Class 'Twilight's Edge' [Charge][Execution] and Special 'Timeless Standstill' [Execution] capitalize, her Special also gives the team +10% damage, and her Passive 'Fleeting Years' stacks self Attack Speed (max +60%) off ALLY Execution use. Xuanji + Leed (downer) + Dusan = a strong Mental-flavored execution core.

SELFISH-CARRY vs SUPPORT-CARRY axis: Grina is a self-contained DPS -- every buff is self-targeted (Class atk-spd/crit-rate, Passive crit-dmg) and her only team-facing hook is Break Point (Interference: -Class CD, +Bonus Damage to the carry she supports). Slot her where a support isn't needed. Her Break Point is a generic offensive interference for ANY Class-skill/salvo carry. For the planned weighting model she is the first pure test case: high coefficient sum but SR base ATK -> likely a top early/F2P DPS that yields to SSR ATK bases late.

HEALER ARCHETYPES (tier-list axis): the support/healer cluster splits by what they add beyond raw HP -- Carmen (peel/shield/taunt), Peseshet (Extreme-damage amp), Maro (Human-race healing + buffs), Zhijie (counter-fueled CD refund), and Doroa (PURE raw throughput: burst+zone Extreme, 194-199% single-target Special, spammable 6s AoE Class, self-sustain Passive) with almost no offense -> the default 'main healer' behind squishy carries. Reusable INTERFERENCE TEMPLATE: Doroa's 'Heart Gazing' and Grina's 'Break Point' share the identical Class-Skill-CD-reduction component (CD -5/-6 base, -9/-10 plus); the second stat swaps by role (Doroa +healing effect, Grina +bonus damage).

DEFENDER ARCHETYPES + TAUNT: the Defender class splits by role -- Carmen (healer/peeler), Garana (ally-def + enemy-damage-taken debuff buffer), Yun (block-counter bruiser), Qing (TAUNT + mitigation: Defense%, Bonus Damage Reduction, Magic Resistance), and Budi (TAUNT + SELF-HEAL/Max-HP sustain + guaranteed-crit Extreme). Two hard-TAUNT Defenders now (Qing, Budi) -> the dedicated aggro magnet to peel enemies off fragile DPS/healers. ROLE-MATCHED INTERFERENCE (recurring pattern): support-slot interference buffs tend to match the wearer's role -- Grina 'Break Point' (+bonus damage, for DPS), Doroa 'Heart Gazing' (+healing effect, for healers), Qing 'Budget Allocation' (block-CD cut + on-block enemy-Attack debuff, for blockers/tanks). Filter interference picks by the carry's role.

ARCANIST-TEAM / EXTREME-SNOWBALL (boss comps): Patra's Passive 'Taking Turns' instantly resets her Class CD when an allied ARCANIST uses Extreme, so an Arcanist-stacked bench (Tomoe, Dusan, Jenny, Yuhong, Grina) directly accelerates her Class->charge->Extreme loop. Each of her Extremes shreds target Magic Resistance (-10%, max -20%) and stacks her own Magic Attack (Interference, max 8) -> she ramps hard on single-target/boss fights. Concrete boss-comp axis: Arcanist enablers + Extreme-damage amp (Peseshet) + Extreme battery (Tomoe) around Patra.
rules_for_tiering: FALSIFIED (was candidate): the 'one plus at 5* + one at 6*' pattern is NOT universal. Canonical stars.json shows Dusan (W001) has BOTH pluses at 6* (Special 6*, Passive 6*). Do NOT infer an unknown plus-unlock from its partner. Most witches do follow 5+6, but treat each plus-unlock as independent and source it directly.

CANONICAL CROSS-CHECK: project stars.json carries plus_unlocks_at_star, authoritative where populated (W001,W002,W005,W006,W009,W010,W011,W012). It matched EVERY owner-confirmed capture incl. Carmen 6* with zero conflicts, confirmed the Tomoe/Peseshet/Leed 5* inferences, and CORRECTED Dusan Passive 5*->6*. Use it to confirm/fill unlocks; fall back to in-game only where it is null (still null in canon: Jenny both, Zhijie both, Yun both, Lena Interference).

RANK CAPS BY RARITY (from owner): SR witches cap at 6-star. SSR witches progress beyond 6-star into 'Ex ranks' (Ex1+). This is the UNIT star-rank cap, distinct from per-SKILL levels (cf. rule #5 'EX 1-3 = skill levels 7-10'). Consistent with rule #10 (pluses unlock at 5*/6*, which both rarities reach); SSR Ex-ranks are further progression above that. Bears on card star-display: the 3-slot roster tile (red 1-3 / gold 4-6) covers the full SR range; SSR Ex-ranks likely need an extra marker (unconfirmed).
_meta.weighting_model_note: Effective damage ~ base_ATK (shared by class+rarity, see class_growth) x sum(skill coefficients from skills.json) x damage-affecting self-buffs (weighting_inputs.self_damage_buffs / guaranteed_crit_slots). SR base ATK caps output vs SSR even when coefficients are high (e.g. Budi, Grina).

mechanics_glossary.Block Counter: Class skill that fires after blocking with a target in range.
mechanics_glossary.Dodge Counter: Class skill that fires after a dodge.
mechanics_glossary.Execution: Only affects knocked-down targets; needs a 'downer' to set up.
mechanics_glossary.Charge Amp: Grants self Extreme Skill charge (feeds Extreme economy).
mechanics_glossary.Salvo (Normal/Class/Ultimate): Auto-trigger that fires after a Normal combo / Class skill / Extreme (canonical: NormalFollowUp / ClassFollowUp / ExtremeFollowUp).
mechanics_glossary.Taunt: Forces enemies to target the caster; peels for squishy carries.
mechanics_glossary.Interference: Only active when the witch is slotted as SUPPORT for another unit; buff matches the carry's role (see interference.role_match).

witches.name: Xinzi

interference.name: Gathering of Hatred
interference.effect: Character's Critical Rate +7%. Bonus damage +7% when attacking a target's Physical Weakness.

witches.synergy_note: Dodge-driven burst: her Passive turns evasions into stacking Bonus Damage; Class is a Dodge-Counter with a big damage-reduction window.

witches.name: Jenny

interference.name: Sweet Gaze
interference.effect: Wearer's Mental damage +7.5%. Additional +5% when attacking downed targets.

witches.synergy_note: Downed-target burst carry: her Extreme is a massive single hit that also stuns, and her Special is an [Execution] that only strikes knocked-down enemies — pair her with a knockdown setter and land the Extreme in the downed window. Interference boosts a carry's Mental damage, more vs downed.

witches.name: Zhijie

interference.name: Self-Care
interference.effect: Character's Dodge Value +7%. Each block or evade increases Healing Effect +19%, 1 stack (max 2) (20s).

witches.synergy_note: Counter-fueled support: Close Attention shaves her Special CD every time an ally counters.

witches.name: Yun

interference.name: Open Umbrella
interference.effect: Wearer's Critical Rate +3%. After the wearer uses their Special, own Block CD is instantly reset.

witches.synergy_note: Untouchable duelist: Belt of Calm Winds gives 100% block + fixed 1.5s block/counter CD; stacked with her dodge stats she is very hard to hit, and Quick Dry lets Class and Special reset off each other for rapid-fire casting.

witches.name: Lena

interference.name: Reckless Driving
interference.effect: Physical Attack rate +3%. On counter, deals 50% Physical Attack damage in a rectangular area and grants target Physical Resistance -2%, 1 stack (max 2) (8s).

witches.synergy_note: Counter-attack bruiser: her Class is a [Dodge Counter], her Extreme repositions and shreds with knockback immunity, and her Passive stacks Physical Attack on every dodge. As support, her Interference gives the carry Physical Attack and an on-counter Physical-Resistance shred on enemies.

witches.name: Maro

interference.name: Sacred Prayer's Gift
interference.effect: Character's Attack Speed +14%. When using a Class Skill, grants allies in a circular area Magic Attack rate +15% (9s) (max 1 stack).

witches.synergy_note: Faction-scaling healer: Compassionate Gift only boosts healing of HUMAN-race witches - she spikes on human-heavy teams. Inquisition plus is a focus-fire debuff (target takes +17% dmg).

witches.name: Yuhong

interference.name: Fire Support
interference.effect: Wearer's Dodge CD -7%. Each dodge grants Critical Rate +7%, 1 stack (max 2) (7s).

witches.synergy_note: Dodge-engine crit assassin: Extreme fixes Dodge CD to 2s (plus: Specials +200% while active); Calm Shot is a Dodge-Counter usable during the Extreme; Class pours crit/atk-speed off dodges (her Interference passes the same to a carry she's slotted behind, never to herself); Tactical Comms even feeds off allies' dodges.

witches.name: Alice

interference.name: Rabbit Vault
interference.effect: Character's Crit Damage +14%. Character's Extreme Skill Crit Rate +14%.

witches.synergy_note: Counter-cascade bruiser: her Extreme fixes Dodge/Special/Class CDs to 1s/4s/3s and lets Class fire ignoring trigger conditions for 11s; Class is a Dodge+Block counter whose plus shaves 2s off Special CD; Passive stacks Class & Special bonus damage every time an ally counters (max 7), so she spikes on counter-heavy teams.

witches.name: Lumi

interference.name: Swift Splash
interference.effect: Character's Critical Rate +9%. Each time the character uses a Class Skill, Critical Rate +5%, 1 stack (max 3) (lasts 20s).

witches.synergy_note: Normal-attack Arcanist: Class stacks normal-attack bonus damage 3x (plus tops off with evasion), Passive turns dodges into big attack-speed windows (plus also shaves Special CD), in a support slot her Interference stacks crit rate on the carry off Class casts. Loop: dodge -> attack speed -> more normals -> Class amp.

witches.name: Garana

interference.name: Stacked Resonance
interference.effect: Character's Physical Attack rate +3%. After the character blocks, Physical Attack rate +3%, 1 stack (max 2) (lasts 5s).

witches.synergy_note: Block-tank anchor: Roaring Howl (Extreme) taunts + dizzies while shielding allies' Defense; Class 'Sonic Blast' is a Block Counter that dizzies; Special 'Sound-Breaking Noise' auto-fires off her Extreme/Class casts to nuke + apply a damage-taken debuff; Passive shields allies off her normal-attack finisher; in a support slot her Interference stacks Physical Attack on the carry on block.

witches.name: Carmen

interference.name: Rolling Smoke Effect
interference.effect: Character's Defense +10%. When the character uses their Extreme Skill, applies a displacement resistance reduction 35% effect to enemies in a circular area, 1 stack (max 1) (lasts 9s).

witches.synergy_note: Smoke support-tank: Extreme 'Mist Assault' shields allies (Toughness+Defense) then hits; Special 'Lingering Smoke Escort' rushes to the lowest-HP ally, heals big, and taunts; her Normal HEALS allies on every hit (plus doubles damage + cuts Special CD per hit); Class is a damage-reduction Block Counter; when she backs a carry, her Interference feeds that carry Defense + a displacement-resistance effect (it never touches Carmen herself). A healer/peeler wrapped in a Defender frame.

witches.name: Huarui

interference.name: Step-by-Step Shadow Shattering
interference.effect: Character's Attack Speed +4%. Each time the character uses an Extreme Skill, Attack Speed +9%, 1 stack (max 2) (lasts 30s).

witches.synergy_note: Fire-fist dodge bruiser: Extreme 'Heaven Fallen' is a 5-hit front-loaded nuke whose plus fixes Special CD to 0 for 12s (spam Special during the window); Class 'Wildfire Palm' is a Dodge Counter granting attack speed (plus adds crit damage + doubles the range); Special 'Leg Cruncher' auto-fires off normal-attack finishers; Passive lets a Special follow her 2nd normal and pumps Attack. Dodge -> attack speed -> normals -> Special salvos, all detonated by the Extreme window.

witches.name: Tomoe

interference.name: Flora's Blessing
interference.effect: Character's Physical Attack rate +3%. After the character uses an Extreme Skill, creates a circular zone (lasts 4s) that increases allies' Attack within area by +2.4% per second (lasts 9s) (max 5 stacks).

witches.synergy_note: Extreme-battery crit carry / flex support. Extreme 'Sakura Blade Dance' self-buffs Crit Damage (+50%; plus +80%) then unloads a multi-hit nuke; Passive 'Spring Sakura's Return' instantly resets her Class CD on EVERY Extreme; Class 'Serving Flower Formation' is a Charge Amp that builds her own Extreme charge (+10/stage x4) and drops a team Bonus-Damage zone (plus adds Special-CD reduction + longer zone); in a support slot her Interference drops an ally Attack zone for the carry. Low 180 Charge lets her Extreme often and loop Extreme -> Class reset -> recharge. First SR captured.

witches.name: Peseshet

interference.name: Lantern Guardian Stance
interference.effect: Character's Defense +7%. Character's Extreme Skill charge speed +7%.

witches.synergy_note: Healer + team EXTREME-DAMAGE AMPLIFIER. Extreme 'Guardian Angel' is a big 3-stage single-target heal whose final heal grants that ally +20% Extreme damage (10s); Special 'Sacred Torch' (Class Skill Salvo) fires off her Class skill to grant ALL allies +Extreme damage (8s); Class 'Prayer's Descent' (Normal Attack Salvo) AoE-heals off her normal combos (plus: bigger heal + a bonus activation after an Extreme); her Interference boosts the CARRY's Extreme charge speed when she's slotted behind them (not her own); Passive gives her attack speed while healthy (fuels the normal->Class->Special salvo chain). Purpose-built to pair with Extreme-centric carries.

witches.name: Dusan

interference.name: Impure Alluring Gaze
interference.effect: Character's maximum Health +4%. Character's Normal Attack damage +14%.

witches.synergy_note: EXECUTION specialist. Special 'Void Convergence Gaze' is an [Execution] (downed targets only) that drops a damage zone (plus adds an upfront burst + cuts CD 10->8); Extreme 'Far-Seeing Blood Curse' is a huge single-area nuke (882% + 50 Stagger) that can help down targets itself; Passive 'Forbidden Evil Eye' base buffs her attack speed after HER Execution, and the PLUS re-routes it to trigger off ALLIES' Executions - so she wants a downer + fellow executioner. Class is a long-CD self stagger-value buff; in a support slot her Interference pumps the carry's Normal Attack damage + max HP.

witches.name: Leed

interference.name: Shadow Snare
interference.effect: Character's Dodge Value increased by 5%. After the character activates a Dodge, creates a circular zone on the ground that deals 78% Mental Attack damage to enemies within the area after 1.5s. (The zone is not considered this character's skill)

witches.synergy_note: Stagger engine + EXECUTIONER (the only mental Vanguard). Piles on Stagger everywhere (Extreme 2.5x2, Class +2, Normal +1/hit -> plus +3 on hit3, Passive +2), knocking enemies DOWN, then her Special 'Twin Blades Heart Breaker' is an [Execution] that nukes downed targets (plus 460->603%, CD 8->7). She's self-sufficient for the down->execute loop AND enables Dusan (whose plus passive pays off ALLY Executions). Also dodge-flavored (Class = Dodge Counter, Interference procs on Dodge), so she overlaps the dodge cluster too. Note her Passive/Interference zones deal Magic/Mental Attack damage respectively.

witches.name: Grina

interference.name: Break Point
interference.effect: Character's Class Skill CD -5%. Character's Bonus Damage +2%.

witches.synergy_note: Selfish self-buff DPS: a Special-centric carry who piles crit and bonus damage on herself and tightens her own loop — give her the damage seat. Interference 'Break Point' (support only) trims the carry's Class-Skill CD and adds Bonus Damage; it never buffs Grina herself.

witches.name: Doroa

interference.name: Heart Gazing
interference.effect: Character's Class Skill CD -5%. Character's healing effect +5%.

witches.synergy_note: Pure raw-throughput healer: the biggest straight heals in the roster, no damage pretensions — just keeping the team alive. Interference 'Heart Gazing' cuts the carry's Class CD and boosts their healing received.

witches.name: Qing

interference.name: Budget Allocation
interference.effect: Character's block CD -10%. When the character blocks, enemies' Attack -5% (lasts 4 seconds) (max 3 stacks).

witches.synergy_note: Taunt/mitigation anchor: a hard-taunt Defender with layered self-mitigation (Defense, damage reduction, Magic Resistance) and an on-block enemy Attack debuff — built to eat hits and protect the carry. Interference cuts the carry's block CD and adds an on-block enemy-Attack debuff.

witches.name: Xini

interference.name: Fancy Footwork
interference.effect: Character's Critical Rate +5%. Character's Extreme Skill Bonus Damage +6%.

witches.synergy_note: Dodge-driven spam carry: evasions fuel rapid Extreme/Special casts, and her kit lands a knockdown that doubles as control (handy for the slime's wake-up). A high-uptime, budget-friendly pick. Interference gives the carry crit rate and Extreme bonus damage.

witches.name: Patra

interference.name: Weakening Breath
interference.effect: Character's Extreme Skill damage +6%. Each time the character's Extreme Skill deals damage to enemies, the character's Magic Attack rate +2.1% (lasts 10 seconds) (max 5 stacks).

witches.synergy_note: Extreme-snowball boss-killer: a charge-amp carry who fires her Extreme over and over, so her ceiling rides on charge economy rather than an evolution — ideal for long single-target boss fights. As support, her Interference stacks the carry's Magic Attack and Extreme damage.

witches.name: Xuanji

interference.name: Fading Light
interference.effect: Character's Special Attack CD -8%. Character's Bonus Damage when attacking a downed target +6%.

witches.synergy_note: Downed-target executioner: her damage explodes against knocked-down enemies, so she snowballs behind a knockdown/control setter — pure single-target execution. Interference 'Fading Light' (support slot) shaves the carry's Special CD and adds bonus damage vs downed targets.

witches.name: Budi

interference.name: Undead Whisper
interference.effect: Character's Critical Power +9%. Character's Magic Resistance +9%.

witches.synergy_note: Self-sustaining taunt tank: holds aggro while healing herself and padding max HP, with a guaranteed-crit Extreme for real chip damage and one of the highest block rates in the class. Interference feeds the carry Crit Power and Magic Resistance.

witches.name: Isabelle

interference.name: Flawless Strategy
interference.effect: Character's Attack +5%; after the carry uses their Extreme, grants the carry a Defense stack (max 3, 30s).

witches.synergy_note: Taunt tank built around survival and debuff: her Extreme self-buffs Defense then hits a big AoE with heavy Stagger (up to 12) and Taunt, and her Passive refills her Extreme gauge for near-constant uptime while stacking enemy Attack-reduction. Best-in-class Stagger, but she rarely blocks (lowest rate of any Defender) and is physically weak — more a utility / Law piece than a damage pull.
